title: ERC-20 Token Deployment
description: Deploy a custom ERC-20 token on a local blockchain with minting, burning, and transfer functionality.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Write, compile, and deploy a custom ERC-20 token smart contract on a local Hardhat blockchain. Implement minting, burning, and transfer functions with proper access control.

### Environment
- Ubuntu 22.04 LTS with Node.js 20
- Hardhat and OpenZeppelin pre-installed
- Working directory: /opt/erc20-lab

### Tasks
1. Initialize a Hardhat project with Solidity 0.8.x
2. Create an ERC-20 token contract inheriting OpenZeppelin ERC20
3. Add mint function with onlyOwner modifier
4. Add burn function that destroys caller's tokens
5. Add token metadata (name, symbol, decimals)
6. Write deployment script using Hardhat Ignition or ethers
7. Deploy to local Hardhat network
8. Write tests verifying token functionality

### Permissions & Access
- Container runs as root
- Node.js 20, Hardhat, and OpenZeppelin pre-installed
- Local blockchain starts automatically
tasks: Initialize a Hardhat project with Solidity 0.8.x
Create an ERC-20 token contract inheriting OpenZeppelin ERC20
Add mint function with onlyOwner modifier
Add burn function that destroys caller's tokens
Add token metadata (name, symbol, decimals)
Write deployment script using Hardhat Ignition or ethers
Deploy to local Hardhat network
Write tests verifying token functionality

title: NFT Marketplace Smart Contracts
description: Build NFT marketplace smart contracts with listing, buying, and royalty support using ERC-721.
briefing:
### Mission Objective
Develop a complete NFT marketplace using Solidity smart contracts. Implement ERC-721 NFT minting, marketplace listing, buying, and creator royalty payments using the EIP-2981 standard.

### Environment
- Ubuntu 22.04 LTS with Node.js 20
- Hardhat, OpenZeppelin, and Ethers.js
- Working directory: /opt/nft-marketplace-lab

### Tasks
1. Create an ERC-721 NFT contract with metadata URI
2. Implement the marketplace contract for listings
3. Add buy function with ETH transfer to seller
4. Implement creator royalties (EIP-2981)
5. Add listing fee mechanism for marketplace revenue
6. Create auction functionality for NFTs
7. Write comprehensive tests for all marketplace functions
8. Deploy and verify contracts on local network

### Permissions & Access
- Container runs as root
- Node.js 20 and Hardhat pre-installed
- OpenZeppelin contracts available

title: Smart Contract Upgrade Pattern
description: Implement upgradeable smart contracts using the proxy pattern with storage slot management.
briefing:

Implement the proxy upgrade pattern for smart contracts using OpenZeppelin's upgradeable contracts. Deploy an initial version, upgrade to v2, and verify state preservation across upgrades.

### Environment
- Ubuntu 22.04 LTS with Node.js 20
- Hardhat and OpenZeppelin Upgrades plugin
- Working directory: /opt/upgradeable-lab

### Tasks
1. Create an upgradeable V1 contract with proxy pattern
2. Deploy using OpenZeppelin Upgrades plugin
3. Create a V2 contract that adds new functionality
4. Upgrade the proxy to V2 implementation
5. Verify state is preserved after upgrade
6. Add storage gap pattern for future upgrades
7. Implement initializer pattern instead of constructor
8. Write tests for upgrade scenarios

### Permissions & Access

- Node.js 20, Hardhat, and OZ Upgrades pre-installed
